PROVIDING MANPOWER SERVICES 
AT BMCRI SUPER SPECAILITY HOSPITAL (PMSSY)

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should have minimum experience of 3 years in the field of providing Manpower Services business. The tenderer should have provided the Similar Manpower services to any Central/State Government / Semi-Government / PSU / Private Institution / Hospital with a minimum deployment of 200 personnel or 80% of the tendered manpower quantity (whichever is higher) cumulatively during the financial years (2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26).

The Tenderer should have on their name minimum two works on hand as on the last date of submission of tender.A self-attested certificate in the letterhead of the Tenderer is required to be submitted by the Tenderer.
Annual Turnover Certificate certified by The CA for Last 3 years with minimum 40 lakhs Turnover
